errors.evidence: The description identifies the first category on the x-axis as "股东回购" (shareholder repurchase), but the label in the figure is "股份回购" (share repurchase). While the meaning is very similar, the text is not an exact match of the label.

The description incorrectly identifies the last category on the x-axis as "违约" (default). The actual label in the figure is "被约谈" (being summoned for a talk). The incorrect label is used both in the list of categories and when reporting the value of the last bar.
